text:
jess ramos: heads up — my daycare gave me two weeks notice and I’m supposed to come back from parental leave next Monday. can I request a temporary reduced schedule (4hr days) + remote for two weeks while I sort backup? do we have stipend/advance options to cover emergency childcare?
michelle (People Ops): so sorry! yes — we support temporary phased returns and emergency childcare help. two steps: 1) submit a temporary transition request form (link below), 2) ask your manager to approve the short-day remote schedule. we can fast-track the stipend review.
jess ramos: thanks. link? payroll cutoff is Fri so trying to avoid miscoding.
michelle (People Ops): form: https://intranet.redwood/care/transition-request — choose "temporary childcare disruption" and set requested dates. note in the form if you want the stipend advance. please submit by EOD Thu for payroll coding.
tara (Manager): Tara here — I can approve the 4hr days and remote for the first two weeks. jess, please tag me on the form and i'll confirm so payroll has an approval record. :+1:
lina (Benefits): childcare stipend policy: up to $1,200 one-time emergency grant (taxable) or a short-term advance against future stipend. to request an advance we need the form + a short note about vendor/pending start date. benefits will confirm within 24 hours.
ben (Caregiving Fund): pinged — we can front funds for up to 2 weeks of care while benefits processes. ben@ will DM you a short agreement; no need for medical docs for this case.
payroll-bot: Reminder: to ensure correct paycoding, mark time as either "Temporary Reduced Schedule - Parental Return" (paid) or "Intermittent Childcare - Unpaid". If stipend advance is provided, it will be coded separately as "Care Stipend Advance" and appear on next payroll.
jess ramos: i'm on an O1 visa — does taking reduced hours for a couple weeks affect visa status?
michelle (People Ops): good question — for short, temporary schedule changes (<=30 days) we treat it as an approved accommodation and it doesn't affect employment authorization. if you plan longer changes or international travel, we’ll loop in Legal.
jess ramos: awesome. i'll file the transition form now and tag tara + ben. appreciate the quick replies. :pray:
